title: Sequin Lace Round Neck Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
This formal evening dress pairs a sequin lace bodice with a softly flowing skirt for a look that feels elegant and polished. The round neckline gives the upper body a refined finish, while the short sleeves offer light coverage. Finished with a defined waist and graceful movement through the skirt, it is a beautiful choice for black tie events, wedding celebrations, and mother of the bride occasions.


Tips: Prioritize the bust measurement when selecting, the fabric is highly elastic and can stretch by at least 2 inches. Consider the waist measurement next, and disregard the hip measurement.

 

Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises lace.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
